summary: Executed public-preview mobile smoke flow and four backend API regression tests.

minor.issue: Source uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL/extra.backendUrl while the environment contract names EXPO_BACKEND_URL; current preview works because EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL is present.

action_items: Align frontend API environment variable usage with the protected EXPO_BACKEND_URL contract, or explicitly document EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL as canonical.
Add an assertion/visible state confirmation for completed task in future regression coverage.
critical_code_review_comments: No authentication/session layer exists yet; MVP intentionally uses hardcoded demo_user_a, so partner permissions and private ownership are not enforced.
External Google Calendar, My Calendar, Instagram, and WhatsApp connectors are READY/PLACEHOLDER surfaces, not live integrations per PRD.

success_rate.frontend: 100% core flow (load, create/toggle task, invite, growth); auxiliary error scan harness check invalid

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_-prefixed profiles, items, and invites through API tests; no production seed changes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public preview loaded at mobile viewport 375x667 with no horizontal overflow. Task creation, task tap/toggle, invite code display, Sync and Growth tabs passed.
rca_of_issue: The only observed failure was in the test harness error scan: JavaScript selector string used nested single quotes and caused a SyntaxError after all app assertions passed. This is not an application failure; fix selector quoting in the next test script.
